create: axios: factory method building a configured instance
head: axios: instance method, HTTP HEAD
request: suss: input role; also axios's instance method sending the request a config object describes
url: axios: config field with the request path
method: axios: config field with the HTTP method
data: axios: AxiosResponse field holding the body
status: axios: AxiosResponse field holding the status code
headers: axios: AxiosResponse field holding the headers
body: suss: response field the binding carries
statusCode: suss: response field the binding carries
